exact_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: faithful Silent Storm painted equipment diffuse UV bitmap.

Input image1 is the EXACT complete original storedRGB source exposed only by whole NEAREST source-only enlargement. Faithfully refine the same entire source paint at higher resolution, very subtly. The entire bitmap remains edge-to-edge, same aspect/normalized UV, all black/shadow/gap areas, original marks/count/scale/phase/colors and local weak tonal hierarchy. Flat UV artwork, not an object photograph. Original sourceA is independently retained and brightness globally calibrated numerically.

Preserve EXACT eight source bitmap paintfield groups: upper-left brown shaped field; middle-left dark horizontal gray field; lower-left brown vertical field; ONE central narrow subdued gray tinychecker field; ONE lower-middle tapered brown field; ONE small upper-middle round gray mark; ONE narrow middle-right irregular brown painted field; and ONE right palegray blade-shaped field. Keep the tinychecker exact native pixel density, spacing and row phase from image1, including dim irregular original interruptions, not a new large grip/knurl pattern. Exactly TWO existing flat muted warm marks on this field near original native53,69 and53,93 remain painted small marks with source colors181/138/123 and165/134/115; NEVER turn them into screws/raised rivets or add others. Existing right pale-gray blade outline and inner gray stroke keep their current widths and strength, no extra sharp white bevel or metalglare. Preserve black gaps and brown fields subdued/source softness; do not add leather pores/stitching/woodgrain.

Maintain original matte paint and softly shaded gray/brown/color fields at the source grain frequency. Preserve existing weak pale paint, dark areas and original outlines without turning them into brightmetal/glintyrod/raised bevel/rims/newhardware/bolts/straps/embossed lettering/physical coarsegrain/etched scratches/photo weave/rust chunks/pores. No new parts, seams, folds, dents, holes, markings/text or stronger specular highlights. Do not regularize tiny native phases or idealize source asymmetry.

Output the ENTIRE opaque storedRGB texture canvas only; exact original composition and source material softness. No crop/BBox/zoom/padding/whiteframe/recentering/object render/cutout/registration/repacking. Alpha, native Type, runtime binding and sourceUV remain original.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST4x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
